text: Pogačar can afford to cruise—a flat stage is his gift, a chance to recover before the Alps deliver their verdict on whether Evenepoel's unconventional third-week gambit actually works. Watch Red Bull push early to test legs and steal time before the mountains arrive, because with only four minutes separating second from fifth, a single bad day in the high passes could reshuffle the entire podium. Del Toro and Seixas will shadow each other ruthlessly today, both Tour debutants knowing that losing ground on terrain this forgiving would be a catastrophic mental blow heading into the decisive climbs.
